system.name: InfiAgent-DABench
system.one_liner: A benchmark and agent framework (DAEval: 603 questions on 124 CSV files) evaluating LLM agents on end-to-end data analysis with a Python sandbox.

content.variant_note: one real benchmark item traced through the agent's ReAct loop, answer reformatting and matching with the closed-form label
content.argues: An LLM agent solves an open-ended data analysis question end to end in a ReAct loop with a Python sandbox, and a reformatted answer can be matched automatically against a closed-form label.
content.subject: One data-analysis question with its CSV file, the agent's code and sandbox output, the final answer, and the closed-form label it is matched with.

elements.name: Problem
elements.role: the data analysis question given to the agent (linear relationship between GDP per capita and life expectancy score, judged by R-squared)
elements.drawn_as: grey rounded card with a grey title tab; key phrases in red and the file name in navy

elements.name: Happiness_rank.csv
elements.role: the CSV file the question refers to: country, happiness rank, GDP per capita, life expectancy and more columns
elements.drawn_as: grey card with a tab holding a small file icon and the blue file name, above a table with a blue header row, pale-blue rows and '...' cells; two column headers in red

elements.name: LLM Agent
elements.role: the evaluated agent: states its plan and writes Python code as 'python sandbox input'
elements.drawn_as: white rounded card with the OpenAI logo and a bold title; a plan sentence followed by a syntax-highlighted monospace code block

elements.name: Python Sandbox
elements.role: executes the agent's code and returns STDOUT
elements.drawn_as: white card with the Python logo and bold title; green monospace 'STDOUT:' and the printed number 0.6666363295228102

elements.name: ReAct ×N
elements.role: names the plan-code-observe loop between agent and sandbox and says it repeats N times
elements.drawn_as: bold text between two curved black arrows

elements.name: Final Answer
elements.role: the agent's concluding natural-language answer: R-squared approximately 0.67, a poor fit
elements.drawn_as: white card with grey title tab; '0.67' and 'poor fit' in bold green

elements.name: Closed-form Label
elements.role: the stored ground truth in closed form: {@coefficient_determination[0.67], @model_fit['poor fit']}
elements.drawn_as: white card with grey title tab; red '@' field names, green values

elements.name: Prompt
elements.role: hands the question to the agent
elements.drawn_as: bold label above a black arrow from the sample box to the LLM Agent card

elements.name: CSV File
elements.role: makes the file available to the sandbox
elements.drawn_as: bold label above a black arrow from the sample box to the Python Sandbox card

elements.name: Reformat
elements.role: converts the final answer into the closed-form format
elements.drawn_as: bold label above the leftward arrow between Final Answer and Closed-form Label

elements.name: Matching
elements.role: compares the reformatted answer with the closed-form label
elements.drawn_as: bold label below the same leftward arrow

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a benchmark by tracing one real item through the whole evaluation: the input card with key phrases coloured, the agent's real code and tool output, then the reformatted answer matched against the closed-form label, every arrow named by what it carries.
lessons.suits: Benchmarks and agent evaluations where one worked item can show inputs, tool use, answer extraction and scoring in a single figure.

evidence: It plans, writes code, calls a Python sandbox and concludes to solve the problem in a ReAct way.
The final answer is reformatted into specific format and matched with the closed-form label.

summary: InfiAgent-DABench is a benchmark for LLM-based agents on end-to-end data analysis: DAEval has 603 questions over 124 CSV files, each turned into a closed-form format so answers can be checked automatically, plus an agent framework and the DAAgent model. Figure 1 follows one real item through the evaluation. A question about the linear relationship between GDP per capita and life expectancy (key phrases in red) and its CSV table sit in a thick-framed box. The question is prompted to an LLM Agent card (OpenAI logo) that writes Python code; a Python Sandbox card (Python logo) returns STDOUT in a ReAct x N loop; the Final Answer is reformatted and matched against the Closed-form Label. Arrows carry bold verb labels; grey cards with title tabs hold real text, code and values.
summary_zh: InfiAgent-DABench评测大模型智能体做数据分析，含603题、124个CSV。图1用一道真题走完流程：问题与CSV交给LLM Agent，它在Python沙箱里ReAct循环写代码，最终答案重整格式后与封闭式标签匹配。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The table, the question, the code and the answers are recorded as examples (live text and vector cells), not pictures; only the OpenAI and Python logos are bitmaps (13 pt each). The thick-framed box has no title of its own.
